# Marimo Studio 0.1.4

Marimo Studio 0.1.4 mounts optional Lens feedback in development previews and
connects custom-view selections to notebook inputs and rendering source.

## Lens feedback

- Development previews reuse a notebook's Lens instance or create one when Lens
  is installed. Feedback remains attached through view rebuilds, and ownership
  follows notebook instance replacement.
- Projected cells, rich outputs, and values publish their producing cell and
  symbolic selector through the Lens client metadata contract. Rendering
  locations come from the authored projection source, and explicit labels and
  rendering references retain author ownership.
- Lens 0.1.0 preserves captured descriptions through notes, History, reopen,
  and agent context. Its isolated controls and bounded image context support
  custom Studio views alongside native notebook outputs.
- Examples and starter guidance use the shared client metadata. The athletes
  cards declare their rendering source and preferred image container.

## Upgrade and compatibility

The optional `marimo-studio[lens]` extra requires `marimo-lens>=0.1.2`.
Custom regions must use `data-marimo-lens-inputs` in place of
`data-marimo-sources` to reference their existing projection hosts.

Marimo Studio 0.1.4 supports Python 3.10 through 3.14 and Marimo 0.24.2.
React, Reveal.js, and Svelte authoring use optional Deno 2.9.5.

[All changes since 0.1.3](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-studio/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.4)
